controls: Python verifier captures raw command stdout/stderr and emits only status codes.
Direct CI pytest safety and PostgreSQL lanes use a wrapper that emits test counts without case identifiers or assertion text.
Branch-coverage lane captures pytest output and emits only the safe summary.
The CI workflow has no artifact upload action.
CI provenance reports bind source and dataset digests without transcript or case content.
limitations: This guards repository-controlled CI output paths and repository workflow artifacts; it cannot attest to GitHub platform-side retention controls or logs from future external workflows.
